## 主张 Claim

在依存网的逐步读法上，保留 living（活跃且不侵蚀），在交互之外加入两种只有一类关系项的读法才有的关系。以之为生：一个形成在某步汲取一个关系项、并以正需要依存于它（LivesOn）；这样的事件与该关系项的事件相关（sustenance）。它与交互一样不是免费的：在 Dependent 之下，活跃的形成只以在该步活跃的体现关系项为生（LivesOn.active）。它使只依存于对方的蜂与花连通（Mutualism.apart_sustenance_connected），而共同参与与交互都不连通它们。在 N_rel 之下，珍视一个以某关系项为生的事件，就珍视该关系项的每个活的事件，反之亦然（living_on_reaches、lived_on_reaches）：珍视狐的进食，就到达兔的活。世系：一个关系项从一个形成而来，当后者在某步给予它、它跨该步开始作为条件而在（Descends）；世系使两个关系项的每个事件相关（descent）。在平衡且只有活跃形成给予的流中，生起的体现关系项从在该步活跃的另一个形成而来（Embodied.descends），这个形成不必体现；于是在 N_rel 之下，珍视这个形成的任一事件，就到达由它而来的关系项的每个活的事件，反之亦然（descent_reaches、ancestry_reaches、arisen_reached）。世代各由前一代给予时，世系使它们连通，共同参与与交互都不连通它们，G0 在那里恰等于种子加 N_rel 加 N_std（Brood.descended）。世系跟着开始作为条件而在走，不跟着生起走：种子从在它休眠时供给它的父代而来（Provisioned.descends），从休眠中醒来不从任何形成而来（Sleeper.no_descent）。两种读法都用到哪个条件就是哪个关系项：把只依存于对方的蜂与花的条件互换，共同参与与交互的连通不变（都不连通），以之为生的连通由有变无（Mutualism.relabel_sustenance）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / On the stepwise reading of a web, keep living (active and not undermining) and add to interaction two relations that only a reading with one kind of relatum has. Living on: a formation draws at a step on a relatum and depends on it at a positive need there (LivesOn), and such an event is related to that relatum's events (sustenance). Like interaction it is not free: under Dependent an active formation lives only on an embodied relatum active at that step (LivesOn.active). It connects a bee and a flower that depend only on each other (Mutualism.apart_sustenance_connected), which neither co-participation nor interaction connects. Under N_rel, valuing an event that lives on a relatum reaches every living event of that relatum, and conversely (living_on_reaches, lived_on_reaches): valuing the fox's eating reaches the hare's living. Descent: a relatum descends from a formation that gives to it at a step across which it comes to stand (Descends), and descent relates every event of the one relatum to every event of the other (descent). In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum that arises descends from another formation active at that step (Embodied.descends), which need not be embodied; so under N_rel, valuing any event of that formation reaches every living event of the relatum descending from it, and conversely (descent_reaches, ancestry_reaches, arisen_reached). Generations each given by the one before are connected by descent and by neither co-participation nor interaction, and G0 there is exactly a seed with N_rel and N_std (Brood.descended). Descent follows coming to stand, not arising: a seed descends from the parent that provisioned it while dormant (Provisioned.descends), and waking from dormancy descends from nothing (Sleeper.no_descent). Both readings use which condition is which relatum: relabelling the conditions of the bee and the flower that depend only on each other, each onto the other, leaves the connection of co-participation and interaction as it was (none) and removes the connection by living on (Mutualism.relabel_sustenance). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 一类关系项的读法：条件与形成共用索引，哪个条件就是哪个关系项由共同的索引给出（relabel，见 life-as-condition-of-life）。 / The one-kind reading: conditions and formations share an index, and which condition is which relatum is supplied by the shared index (relabel, see life-as-condition-of-life).
- sustenance 与 descent 是 related 的两种读法，是对应前提：它们是否算作 N_rel 所传递的形成关系，由 Ren 选择。N_rel 本身仍是前提（metaethical-core-characterization）。 / sustenance and descent are two readings of related, correspondence premises: whether they count as formed relations along which N_rel transmits is Ren's choice. N_rel itself remains a premise (metaethical-core-characterization).
- Embodied.descends 与 arisen_reached 需要流平衡依存网、只有活跃形成给予（Acting），以及生起的关系项体现。 / Embodied.descends and arisen_reached need the flow to balance the web, only active formations to give (Acting), and the arising relatum to be embodied.

Becoming.Metaethics 把 related 读作形成的关系，列出条件、依存、世系与合作；此前的读法只经由共同的条件相关，life-as-condition-of-life 记下“直接读出体现的估值”为下一步，Mutualism.apart 是其反例：蜂与花都体现、互相依存，却不相关。本结果在一类读法中给出两种直接的关系：以之为生对应条件化与依存，世系对应世系。以之为生要求正需要的依存，所以沿用交互的纪律（连通由活的使用造成）；世系要求正的给予与开始作为条件而在，所以不由空的给予造成。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。在把体现的关系项读作“生”这一属于 Ren 的读法下（整合文档 §23 K6），作者把世系读作原话中两个“生”之间关系的一种形式内容：生起者由给予它的展开而来，并经由世系与整体相关（AI 论证）；这不替代原话，不推出生起是好的，也不决定 Ren 是否采用这些关系。 / Becoming.Metaethics reads related as formed relation and lists conditioning, dependence, descent and cooperation; the earlier readings relate only through a shared condition, life-as-condition-of-life records ‘a valuation reading embodiment directly’ as a next step, and Mutualism.apart is its counterexample: a bee and a flower, both embodied and depending on each other, are unrelated. This result gives two direct relations in the one-kind reading: living on corresponds to conditioning and dependence, descent to descent. Living on requires dependence at a positive need, keeping the discipline of interaction (connection is made by living use); descent requires a positive gift and coming to stand, so no empty giving makes it. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). Taking embodied relata as 生, a reading that is Ren's (§23, K6, of the integration note), the author reads descent as one formal content of the relation between the two 生 in those words: what arises comes from the unfolding that gives it, and is related to the whole through descent (an AI argument); it does not replace Ren's words, does not show that arising is good, and does not decide whether Ren adopts these relations.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

Ren 是否采用以之为生与世系作为 N_rel 所传递的关系；排定时间、对效果敏感的以之为生；世系的传递闭包（祖先）与有限步内的世系；整段读法上的同一关系；把世系与 C 联系，即带来新的生起是否使结果更好（Ren）；与 universal_reason 的“新的活的内容”接通。 / Whether Ren adopts living on and descent as relations along which N_rel transmits; an ordered, effect-sensitive living on; the transitive closure of descent (ancestry) and descent within finitely many steps; the same relations for the whole-run reading; relating descent to C, whether bringing about new arising makes an outcome better (Ren); connecting to universal_reason's ‘new living content’.
